summary: Focused visual-contrast check of CTA button fix on /pay/payment-states-demo and /pay/demo (client-side sandbox pages, no backend calls). Verified computed styles of primary CTA buttons in DARK and LIGHT modes across all Overpay toggle states. Pages render correctly (no blank-paint issue in this env). Bug fix verified as WORKING on payment-states-demo (OverPayment CTA). On /pay/demo, the Done step actually renders a demo-specific inline success card with an outlined 'demo-reset-btn', NOT the TransferExpectedCard — so the fix is not exercised there (expectation mismatch in review request).

issues: Header icon SVG inside the OverPayment card renders in indigo rgb(68,76,231) = #444CE7. Not on the reviewer's blocklist (#4338CA / #0004FF), so treated as intentional icon color. Reporting for awareness.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider re-styling the OverPayment header piggy/wallet icon (#444CE7 indigo) to align with the lime/near-black theme if the design intent was to remove all indigo accents. Currently readable but visually inconsistent with theme.

CLARIFICATION for main agent: The /pay/demo Done step does NOT render TransferExpectedCard. It uses an inline demo success card (pages/pay/demo.tsx lines ~660–725) with an OUTLINED 'Try the demo again' button (data-testid='demo-reset-btn'), not 'return-btn'/'done-btn'. So the TransferExpectedCard contrastText fix is not exercised by walking /pay/demo. If you want that path tested, either add a route/toggle in /pay/demo that renders TransferExpectedCard, or rely on /pay/payment-states-demo (which does render OverPayment / TransferExpectedCard-family CTAs and PASSED).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix verified in code: Components/UI/TransferExpectedCard/Index.tsx return-btn (line 459-460) and done-btn (line 496-497) use theme.palette.primary.contrastText and hover uses (primary as any).hover with fallback to primary.dark — clean.
Components/UI/OverPayment/Index.tsx line 454 also uses theme.palette.primary.contrastText — clean.
TransferExpectedCard line 277 DoneIcon color:'#fff' on the green #12B76A success circle is intentional and correct (white check on green).
No hardcoded #4338CA / #0004FF remain in scanned DOM on the two demo pages.
Minor: (primary as any).hover typing bypass — consider extending the MUI PaletteColor type augmentation to declare `hover` so the `as any` cast is unnecessary.

rca_of_the_issue: Bug fix confirmed correct at code + runtime. The previous hardcoded color: '#fff' on OverPayment/TransferExpectedCard CTA buttons produced unreadable white-on-lime in dark mode. Fix replaces color with theme.palette.primary.contrastText (which is #060606 near-black in dark, #CCFF00 lime in light), and hover replaces the leftover indigo #4338CA with (theme.palette.primary as any).hover. Runtime confirms bg=rgb(204,255,0) + color=rgb(6,6,6) in dark and bg=rgb(10,10,10) + color=rgb(204,255,0) in light — meeting WCAG AAA contrast.
